questions.question: What are the benefits of making an array a member of a class? / [CO3]
questions.solution_html: • What are the benefits of making an array a member of a class? Array data is encapsulated along with other class members Access and manipulation are restricted to the class's member functions, protecting the data The array is intrinsically tied to the object's identity and purpose, improving class design. The array is created and destroyed automatically when the class object is instantiated or destroyed. The array becomes a simple part of the overall object state, making the object easier to manage as a single unit. (Any two valid points: 2 marks) 2
